nodes.summary: A group $G$ is relatively free if it has a family $(x_i)_{i \in I}$ of elements that generates $G$ such that for every family $(y_i)_{i \in I}$ of elements of $G$ there is an endomorphism $\varphi$ of $G$ with $\varphi(x_i) = y_i$ for all $i \in I$.
nodes.title: Relatively free group

nodes.summary: Hall's verbal finiteness conjecture for relatively free groups is false: there are a relatively free group $G$, a natural number $n$ and a word $v$ in the free group on $n$ generators such that $v$ takes only finitely many values on $G$ but the verbal subgroup $v(G)$ of $G$ generated by these values is infinite.
nodes.title: Hall's conjecture fails for relatively free groups

nodes.summary: The statement that for every relatively free group $G$, every $n \in \mathbb{N}$ and every word $v$ in the free group on $n$ generators, if $v$ takes only finitely many values on $G$, then the verbal subgroup $v(G)$ of $G$ generated by these values is finite.
nodes.title: Hall's verbal finiteness conjecture for relatively free groups (Kourovka 12.31)

nodes.summary: For a word $v$ in the free group on $n$ generators and a group $G$, the set of values of $v$ on $G$ is the set of elements $v(g_1, \dots, g_n)$ obtained by substituting elements $g_1, \dots, g_n \in G$ for the generators, that is, the set of images of $v$ under all homomorphisms from that free group to $G$.
nodes.title: Values of a word

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
